crossRefs.note: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by…
Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his…
For we know in part and we prophesy in part;
Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
Those who strive with Yahweh shall be broken to pieces. He will thunder against them in the sky. “Yahweh will judge the…
Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.

translations.web: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
translations.bsb: Indeed, these are but the fringes of His ways; how faint is the whisper we hear of Him! Who then can understand the thunder of His power?”
translations.kjv: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
translations.asv: Lo, these are but the outskirts of his ways: And how small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?
